items.title: Scott Robinson interviewed by Monk Rowe,Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: I was just asked to write liner notes so that will be a first. I mean I wrote my own liner notes once before but this is for Storyville Records, a record by Klaus Suonsaari

ctx.x: Cool. What about — you’ve also done some writing for publications?

Oh, not too much. I did an article for Saxophone Journal about the bass sax, and I was just asked to write liner notes so that will be a first. I mean I wrote my own liner notes once before but this is for Storyville Records, a record by Klaus Suonsaari, the great © Hamilton Fillius Archive -8-
Finnish drummer. I enjoy a little bit of writing. I’m not like my father, he’s a real writer. He’s retired from National Geographic, and he can really write. For me it’s kind of a laborious process.
